characterList.description: A man with long dark hair and glasses, wearing a black t-shirt with "THE EDGE OF TECH" printed on it.
characterList.name: Jim Edgeworth (AKA Nerdy J)

content_metadata.description: A comprehensive guide for beginners on how to start with 3D printing, from selecting a printer to admiring the finished product.

qAndA.answer: Jim recommends PLA because it is easier to print with and cheaper compared to other materials.

qAndA.question: Besides using an SD card, what other methods can be used to send a file to the 3D printer?

qAndA.answer: He compares it to weed whacker line.
